title: Surreal Cinema Projection
description: A woman in a blue and red suit stands inside a giant transparent bubble, holding a lit match and a flashlight that illuminates a shadowy figure making a peace sign on a film reel. The bubble contains floating film elements, green film reels, a burning sign, and butterflies. Outside, an old red film projector casts light while silhouetted audience members in hats watch from red theater seats.
prompt: Surreal scene of a woman in a blue and red suit standing inside a large transparent sphere, holding a lit match in one hand and shining a flashlight with the other at a large shadowy silhouette making a peace sign. Inside the bubble are green film reels, burning film strips, butterflies, and a 'PLAY' sign. Outside the bubble, a vintage red film projector sits on the ground projecting light, with two silhouetted audience members in fedoras watching from red theater seats in the foreground, all set against a dark background with floating clocks and film elements.
